# Harbour Authority Call

With [[Priya Nair]] and Dev from the data team, about the tide predictions behind the [[Tide Data Source]].

## What they said

- A JSON feed is planned for spring 2027. The monthly CSV will carry on for at least a year after that.
- The feed will allow 60 requests per hour per key.
- Predictions are revised when the harbour is dredged, so a cached file can be out by up to 10 cm.

## Actions

- Ask Dev for a test key when the beta opens.
- Keep the CSV import in the app for now.
